National League player box score

Source: R/nationalleague.R
nl_player_box.Rd

One game's player box score: goals, assists, shots, faceoffs, ice time, goaltending.

Usage

nl_player_box(game_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

game_id

SIHF game id, 14 digits <season(4)><competition(4)><sequence(6)> (game_id in nl_schedule(); the same id as the SIHF family's game_id), e.g. 20261105000325. A whole number or a digit string; 14 digits are exact as a double, so do not format them through integer.

return_parsed

Logical. TRUE (the default) returns the fastRhockey_data tibble; FALSE returns the raw JSON body as a nested list (api keys already dropped).

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (38 columns) with the columns below, or the raw JSON body when return_parsed = FALSE. A valid but empty payload returns a zero-row tibble with these columns.

col_nametypedescription
game_idnumericSIHF game id <season(4)><competition(4)><sequence(6)> (whole number; e.g. 20261105000325, 1105 = National League). The same id as the sihf family's game_id; its first four digits are the season END year.
team_sidecharacterhome or away: the side of the team this row belongs to.
team_idnumericSIHF team id (whole number; e.g. 101151 = HC Davos). The same key space as the sihf family's team_id.
player_idnumericSIHF licence number (whole number; e.g. 305519 = Tobias Geisser). Joins the sihf family's player_id and every SIHF *LicenceNr.
numbercharacterSweater number, a string
first_namecharacterFirst (given) name of the player
last_namecharacterLast (family) name of the player
short_namecharacterInitial and last name, e.g. 'S. Aeschlimann'
namecharacterFirst and last name
positioncharactergoalkeeper, defender or forwarder (sic)
fowintegerNumber of faceoffs won
folintegerNumber of faceoffs lost
sogintegerNumber of shots on goal
shmintegerShots that missed the net
shpintegerShots that hit the post
shbintegerOwn shots blocked by an opponent
bksintegerOpponent shots blocked
toiintegerTime on ice, seconds
toi_eqintegerEven-strength time on ice, seconds
toi_ppintegerPower-play time on ice, seconds
toi_pkintegerShorthanded time on ice, seconds
pimintegerPenalty minutes
gintegerNumber of goals scored
a1integerFirst (primary) assists credited
a2integerSecond (secondary) assists credited
plintegerPlus count: on ice for an even-strength or shorthanded goal for
miintegerMinus count: on ice for a goal against
mipintegerGoaltender time played, hundredths of a minute (6000 = 60:00; = seconds / 0.6)
gaintegerGoals against: number of goals conceded
svsintegerNumber of saves made by the goaltender
saintegerShots on goal against
gaanumericGoals-against average; 0 in every sampled row, even for goaltenders who conceded
save_percentagenumericSave percentage, 0-100
faceoffsintegerFaceoffs taken (upstream fo: fow + fol). Not penalties.
faceoffs_percentagenumericFaceoff win percentage (upstream foPercentage); -1 without faceoffs.
aintegerAssists (a1 + a2)
ptsintegerPoints (goals + assists)
pl_miintegerPlus/minus (pl - mi)

Details

robots.txt ruling. www.nationalleague.ch/robots.txt disallows /api. The owner approved building on it on 2026-10-12, for polite, incremental use only: requests are spaced at least one second apart (on every attempt, retries included), and a bulk backfill or a published mirror needs the owner's sign-off first. Crawl incrementally: fetch a finished game once (keyed by game_id), find new games with one nl_schedule() call per run, and fetch season tables at most once per game day.

Seasons are END years and go on the wire unchanged. Ids (*_id) are whole-number numeric (a 14-digit game_id exceeds R's 32-bit integer); every other whole-number column is integer. The club backend key the API ships in /teams/{id}/info is dropped before parsing and never returned.

Endpoint: GET https://www.nationalleague.ch/api/games/{gameId}.

The six game-page wrappers (nl_game_overview(), nl_pbp(), nl_lineups(), nl_player_box(), nl_team_stats(), nl_shots()) each read the same /games/{gameId} body, one request each.

Errors

Raises a classed condition (all inherit fastRhockey_error): fastRhockey_no_data for a 404 or an empty answer (no games or rows for that season, team or phase), fastRhockey_asset_fetch for a failed fetch, an error object in a 200, a body without the ids it must carry, or an answer for another season, team, game or player, and fastRhockey_bad_request for a 400/422 or an argument that is not a whole number.

See also

Other National League Functions: nl_current_games(), nl_game_overview(), nl_lineups(), nl_pbp(), nl_player_season(), nl_player_stats(), nl_playoffs(), nl_playouts(), nl_schedule(), nl_shots(), nl_standings(), nl_team_info(), nl_team_player_stats(), nl_team_schedule(), nl_team_stats(), nl_top_scorers()
